gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Peak Design sells a $29.95 Universal Head Adapter that replaces the Travel Tripod's built-in ball head so you can mount any standard third-party head. It fits both the carbon and aluminum versions and works with or without the center column. A cited rival says the opposite: that the head can't be swapped.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited rivals I could open. findingtheuniverse.com (cited in chat 2) says of the Peak Design Travel Tripod that you 'can't swap it for a different head later'. Peak Design's own adapter page says you can. The same page also says 'Peak Design and Manfrotto use their own plate designs, which work well but tie you into their spares'. Manfrotto's Befree Advanced AS page says its plate holder takes Arca-type plates and also works with Manfrotto's RC2 system. digitalnomads.world (cited in chat 1) only says buyers should 'check compatibility and required adapters'. It names no adapter, part or price for Peak Design. It does cover Ulanzi's non-detachable head and an accessory with a 3/8-inch interface, so the Ulanzi part of this angle is already partly out there. amateurphotographer.com (cited in both chats) returned HTTP 403, so I couldn't check it.
decides: This confirms Peak Design for a shopper who might later add a video or panorama head: adding another head costs a $29.95 adapter, not new legs, which removes the main objection findingtheuniverse raises. On the Ulanzi Zero Y, Ulanzi's own page says the ball head is not detachable and points to a separate F38 center column if you want a different head. So Peak Design and Ulanzi both need an extra part to change heads. The Manfrotto Befree Advanced AS is the only shortlisted pick whose maker page says its plate holder takes both Arca-type and Manfrotto RC2 plates, which suits shoppers who already own Manfrotto plates.

findings.product: Peak Design Travel Tripod (Carbon and Aluminum)
findings.label: Head swap: Universal Head Adapter, which tripods it fits
findings.value: Takes 'any standard 3rd party tripod head'. Fits both the carbon and aluminum Peak Design Travel Tripods. Works with or without the center column. The third-party head is sold separately.
findings.note: Maker page: you remove the Compact Ball Head with the included hex wrench and fit the adapter in its place. The page states no thread size and lists no other exclusions.
